hazards.evidence: The tub has a smooth-looking floor with no visible nonslip mat or traction strips.
The bathtub has a high side to step over, and the shower chair does not extend across the rim as a transfer bench.
The toilet appears to have a standard low seat without a visible raised-seat attachment.
Shoes, clothing, papers, and small loose objects clutter the tub floor and obstruct safe shower access.
